texto: To order education you use «Ik wil graag...» (please...) or «Mag ik...» (can I take...?). To ask if a dish includes any specific ingredient the «Zit er... in?» structure is used (does it carry... inside / contains...?). To ask them to prepare the dish without that ingredient is said «zonder...» (without...).

frases.nl: Natuurlijk. Wilt u er brood bij?
frases.en: Sure. You want bread with her?

frases.nl: Ja, graag. Zit er room in de soep?
frases.es: Sí, por favor. ¿La sopa lleva nata?
frases.en: Yes, please. Is the soup cream?

frases.nl: Ja. Ik kan de soep zonder room brengen.
frases.es: Sí. Puedo traer la sopa sin nata.
frases.en: Yeah. I can bring the soup without cream.

frases.nl: Dat is fijn, dank u. En de rekening, alstublieft.
frases.es: Perfecto, gracias. Y la cuenta, por favor.
frases.en: Perfect, thank you. And the bill, please.

bloques.pregunta: How do you ask in Dutch if a dish contains cream?

opciones.texto: Zit er room in de soep?
opciones.explicacion: «Zit er... in?» is the common structure to ask if a dish carries an ingredient.
She asked if the soup didn't bring sugar, not the cream.
She asked if the soup was cold.

bloques.pregunta: What solution does the waiter propose to the customer?
bloques.frase: Ik kan de soep zonder room brengen.

opciones.texto: You can have the soup without adding cream.
You must choose another dish because all the soup is already cooked with cream.
opciones.explicacion: The waiter clarifies that he can serve it without that ingredient.

opciones.texto: You will be charged a supplement for removing the cream from the preparation.
opciones.explicacion: He does not mention any additional surcharge.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the particle of courtesy equivalent to «I wish.».

opciones.explicacion: «Ik wil graag» is the usual courteous way to order in a restaurant.
«Ik wil zonder» would leave the request incomplete.
«Duur» is an adjective (expensive) that does not fit syntically.

bloques.pregunta: What supplement does the waiter offer to accompany the soup?
bloques.frase: Natuurlijk. Wilt u er brood bij?

opciones.texto: If you want some bread to go with.
If you'd like a glass of red wine.
opciones.explicacion: It doesn't offer alcoholic drinks, just bread.

opciones.texto: If you want a double ration of soup.
opciones.explicacion: Ask for the bread, not for the size of the bowl.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the preposition that excludes the unwanted ingredient.
bloques.frase: Ja. Ik kan de soep ___ room brengen.

opciones.explicacion: «Met» would mean with, the contrary to the request of the client.
«Voor» means for or in front of.

bloques.explicacion: Courteous request structure with auxiliary verb and warning «graag».

intro: Ask for a complimentary meal at the hotel and ask if a dish contains certain ingredients.
